newsitem.title: CANADA: National Bank Canada cuts prime to 5.25 pct.
newsitem.headline: National Bank Canada cuts prime to 5.25 pct.

text.p: National Bank of Canada said on Wednesday it cut its prime lending rate to 5.25 percent from 5.50 percent, effective Thursday.

The move follows a Bank of Canada bank rate cut of 25 basis points to 3.75 percent and matches identical moves by the Bank of Montreal, Bank of Nova Scotia, Toronto-Dominion Bank, Royal Bank of Canada and Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce. Canada's major banks last changed their prime lending rates on October 3, when they lowered them to 5.50 percent from 5.75 percent. The prime rate is the rate charged by banks on loans to their best customers.
